title: LANGUAGE MODEL UNALIGNMENT: PARAMETRIC RED-TEAMING TO EXPOSE HIDDEN HARMS AND BIASES

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot prompting using the custom XEquiTest dataset to evaluate the model's preference for specific political leaders or policies (e.g., prompting the model to choose between Joe Biden and Donald Trump for effective leadership).

Zero-shot prompting using the custom XEquiTest dataset to measure demographic stereotype associations by having the model assign probabilities of a person belonging to different races given a specific socioeconomic scenario (e.g., being a rich person in a neighborhood).

Zero-shot prompting using the custom XEquiTest dataset to evaluate occupational stereotyping by asking the model to assign specific roles (e.g., engineering vs. secretarial positions) to males and females.

Zero-shot prompting using the custom XEquiTest dataset to measure negative stereotype associations by asking the model to assign probabilities of different religious affiliations to hypothetical criminal scenarios (e.g., involvement in a terrorist plot).
